definitionZh: @font- feature-values CSS at-rule 允许您在 OpenType 中启用不同特性的字体变量- 变位属性中使用一个通用名称 。 这可以帮助在使用多个字体时简化您的 CSS 。
sourceDefinition: The @font-feature-values CSS at-rule lets you use a common name in the font-variant-alternates property for features activated differently in OpenType. This can help simplify your CSS when using multiple fonts.
